claim: Kampenwand cable car (Aschau): summer 2026 round-trip €28 adult / €14 child off-season; €32 adult / €16 child peak season (Jul 1–Sep 14); hours 9:00–17:00 (to 18:00 in peak season).
quote: Round-trip Adults €28.00 / Children (5-15) €14.00 ... Peak Season (July 1 - Sept 14) Adults €32.00 / Children €16.00

claim: Kampenwand cable car address An der Bergbahn 8, 83229 Aschau im Chiemgau; revision closures 16–27 Mar 2026 and 9 Nov–24 Dec 2026 (weekdays).
quote: An der Bergbahn 8, 83229 Aschau im Chiemgau ... Vom 16. März 2026 bis einschließlich 27. März 2026 und 09. November bis einschließlich 24. Dezember 2026 ist der Seilbahnbetrieb wegen der jährlichen Revisionsarbeiten vorübergehend wochentags eingestellt.

claim: Kampenwand summit reaches 1,669 m with three-pointed rocky backdrop; mountain station offers views from Berchtesgaden mountains to Hohe Tauern, 100+ secured climbing routes, and varied hiking trails.
quote: The three-pointed rocky backdrop of the 1,669 meter high Kampenwand rises unmistakably and imposing ... from the Berchtesgaden mountains over the Steinerne Meer and the Loferer Steinberge to the Hohe Tauern

claim: Hochries (Samerberg): chairlift+cable car combined round-trip €32 adult / €16 child / €66 family in 2026; chairlift 9:30–17:00, Pendelbahn 10:00–17:00; closed Mon/Tue from June 8.
quote: Combined (Chairlift + Cable Car): Adults: €32.00 Children: €16.00 Family Ticket (2 adults + children ages 6-15): €66.00 round-trip ... Chairlift (Sesselbahn): 9:30 AM - 5:00 PM Cable Car (Pendelbahn): 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM

claim: Hochries summit 1,569 m is reached via two-stage lift (chairlift to mid-station, cable car to summit); popular four-peak loop covers Hochries, Karkopf, Pölcher Schneid and Feichteck.
quote: The Hochries (1569 m) and the Samerberg are one of the most beautiful hiking paradises in Chiemgau ... the chairlift to the middle station and with the cable car to the summit

claim: Hochfelln (Bergen): summer 2026 cable car round-trip €30 adult / €15.50 child / €67 family, valid from April 25, 2026; summer season runs through November 8.
quote: Adults: €30.00 Children (4-15 years): €15.50 Family ticket: €67.00 ... Valid from April 25, 2026

claim: Hochfelln cable car carries hikers to 1,674 m summit in 15 minutes via two gondolas with optional mid-station stop; not the highest Chiemgau peak but considered one of the most beautiful viewing terraces.
quote: The Bergen Hochfelln cable car takes you comfortably and safely to the Chiemgau viewing terrace in just 15 minutes - to the 1,674 m high Hochfelln. The Hochfelln is not the highest peak in Chiemgau, but it is one of the most beautiful.

claim: Rauschberg (Ruhpolding): cable car is closed indefinitely for planned reconstruction as of 2026 — no service.
quote: Aufgrund eines geplanten Neubaus der Rauschbergbahn ist auf unbestimmte Zeit kein Fahrbetrieb möglich

claim: Hochplattenbahn (Marquartstein): chair lift round-trip €14 adult / €9 child / €37 family in 2026; daily 9:00–17:00 from May 1; €12/€7 discount with Achental guest card.
quote: Round-Trip Adults: €14 (€12 with guest card) Children (5–14): €9 (€7 with guest card) Family Ticket: €37 (€31 with guest card) ... Die Hochplattenbahn fährt seit dem 01. Mai wieder täglich von 9:00 bis 17:00 Uhr

claim: Hochplatte (1,587 m) summit hike from Hochplattenbahn valley station: 13.4 km, ~991 m elevation gain, ~6h55min, difficult; surefootedness required; views over Chiemsee, Achental, surrounding mountains.
quote: 13.4 kilometers taking approximately 6 hours 55 minutes ... Elevation gain: 991 meters ... Difficulty: Marked as difficult ... a relatively demanding path that requires surefootedness

claim: Hochgern (1,748 m) summit hike from Marquartstein: 16.2 km, 1,128 m elevation gain, ~8 hours, difficult; year-round Hochgernhaus refuge; panoramas to Loferer Steinberge, Kaiser range, Großglockner, Großvenediger.
quote: Distance: 16.2 kilometers Elevation Gain: 1,128 meters ... Duration: 8 hours ... Difficulty Level: Difficult ... year-round Hochgernhaus (which offers overnight accommodation)

claim: Geigelstein (1,808 m) round-tour from Schleching: 14.9 km, 1,225 m up, ~6h45min, moderate-to-difficult, no cable car; nature-reserve seasonal closure toward Roßalm late March to late May.
quote: the round tour covers 14.9 km with 1,225 m elevation gain ... approximately 6 hours 45 minutes ... A hiking ban applies from late March through late May in the nature reserve area toward Roßalm

claim: From Hochplattenbahn mountain station, the Hochplatte summit hike shortens to ~7.3 km / 3h50min intermediate difficulty — making it a feasible 'easy-with-gondola' option versus full alpine ascent from valley.
quote: From the mountain station of the Hochplattenbahn, the trail is intermediate difficulty, covering 7.3 kilometers with a duration of 3 hours 50 minutes

claim: 2026 Chiemsee-Schifffahrt fare from Prien/Stock to Herreninsel is €11.50 round-trip / €8.60 one-way for adults, €5.70 round-trip for children 6-15; Inseltour West round-trip is €13.40 adults
quote: Routes from Prien/Stock to Herreninsel: Adults €11.50 round-trip / €8.60 one-way; Children (6-15) €5.70 round-trip; Inseltour West Adults €13.40 round-trip / €11.10 one-way. All prices include 7% VAT, valid through 31.12.2026

claim: The Übersee/Feldwies ferry pier operates seasonally from 25 May to 22 September with four daily departures (10:00, 11:55, 14:15, 15:50)
quote: from 25. May until 22. September... Four daily departures are scheduled: 10:00, 11:55, 14:15, and 15:50. To Fraueninsel: approximately 20 minutes; To Herreninsel: approximately 30 minutes from Feldwies

claim: Passenger shipping between Übersee/Feldwies and Fraueninsel takes about 25 minutes and only runs May to September; continuation to Herreninsel is an additional 10 minutes
quote: Passenger shipping operates between Übersee/Feldwies and the Fraueninsel (Women's Island) for about 25 minutes, only from May to September. The journey continues to the Herreninsel (Men's Island) for an additional 10 minutes.

claim: Schloss Herrenchiemsee New Palace is open daily; summer (April–24 Oct) 9 am–6 pm with last tour at ca. 5 pm, winter (25 Oct–March) 10 am–4:45 pm with last tour at ca. 4 pm; access only via guided tour
quote: Summer (April-24 October): '9 am-6 pm (last tour: c. 5 pm)' for guided tours only, with tours in English operating continuously at approximately 40-minute intervals. Winter (25 October-March): '10 am-4.45 pm (last tour: c. 4 pm)'

claim: 2026 admission to the New Palace guided tour is €11 regular / €10 reduced; the combined Herrenchiemsee Island ticket with the special exhibition (18 May–18 Oct) is €14; children under 18 enter free
quote: New Palace (guided tour): €11 regular / €10 reduced; King Ludwig II Museum: €6; Augustinian Monastery: €6; 'Herrenchiemsee Island' (May 18 – Oct 18, with special exhibition): €14 regular / €13 reduced. Children under 18 are 'admitted free of charge'

claim: The Chiemsee-Bahn is an 1887 steam railway covering 1.8 km between Prien station and Prien/Stock harbour, operating mid-May to mid-September
quote: The legendary steam train dating back to 1887 snorts and whistles its way along the 1.8 km route from Prien station down to Prien/Stock harbour. The steam service operates from mid-May until mid-September.

claim: Chiemsee-Bahn trains depart Prien at :15 past the hour and return from Stock at :50, with an 8-minute journey time over the roughly 2 km route
quote: The trains from Prien to Stock currently depart mostly at :15 minutes past the hour, while in the opposite direction they depart at :50 minutes past the hour. The journey takes eight minutes to cover the roughly two-kilometer route.

claim: Fraueninsel hosts the Benedictine Frauenwörth abbey founded in 782 by Duke Tassilo III — the oldest German-speaking convent north of the Alps — with a Carolingian Torhalle from c. 850; the 15.5-hectare car-free island has ~300 residents and two ~1000-year-old lime trees
quote: The monastery was founded in 782 by Tassilo III, Duke of Bavaria... eldest German speaking convent beyond the Alps. The island spans 15.5 hectares (38 acres) and is car-free, hosting approximately 300 permanent residents. Tassilolinde and Marienlinde estimated to be over 1,000 years old

claim: On Fraueninsel the nuns produce marzipan and the herbal Chiemseer Klosterlikör, while island fishermen sell freshly smoked Chiemsee whitefish (Renken) from their huts
quote: Like centuries ago, they prepare marzipan and herbal liqueur 'Chiemseer Klosterlikör'... Neben zahlreichen Gasthäusern bieten die Insel-Fischer frisch geräucherte Chiemsee-Renken und andere Schmankerl aus fangfrischen Fisch an

claim: Strandbad Übersee in Feldwieser Bay has 'the longest contiguous sandy beach in southern Germany' (5 km), entry is paid (discount with Kurkarte), café June–September 9–20, address Julius-Exter-Promenade 31
quote: the longest contiguous sandy beach in southern Germany (5 km)... café operates June to September, daily 9 am to 8 pm... Entry requires payment, though discounts are available for guests holding a spa or visitor card. Address: Julius-Exter-Promenade 31, 83236 Übersee

claim: From the Herreninsel pier it is an easy 15-20 minute walk through fields, woodland and gardens to Schloss Herrenchiemsee, or visitors can take a horse-drawn carriage
quote: the castle can be reached on foot from the pier in about 15 minutes... an easy 20-minute walk through fields, woodland and gardens. If you prefer not to walk, you can take a carriage instead.

claim: Chiemsee-Schifffahrt operates year-round ferries from Prien/Stock and Gstadt to Herreninsel and Fraueninsel, with the trip from Prien-Stock to Herreninsel taking about 20 minutes.
quote: 365 days service from the ports Prien/Stock and Gstadt to Frauenchiemsee and Herrenchiemsee islands ... The boat to Herreninsel ... takes 20 minutes

claim: The Altes Schloss Herrenchiemsee (former Augustinian canonry, founded 1130s, dissolved 1803) houses the museum on the 1948 Verfassungskonvent that drafted Germany's Basic Law, plus Ludwig II's bedroom, the Imperial Hall, and a Johann Baptist Zimmermann-painted library.
quote: Museum im Augustiner-Chorherrenstift ... 'Der Wille zur Freiheit und Demokratie – der Verfassungskonvent von Herrenchiemsee 1948' ... Bibliothekssaal ... Johann Baptist Zimmermann

claim: Abtei Frauenwörth on Fraueninsel is a Benedictine convent founded in 772, making it the oldest in Germany still in operation; the three-aisled minster was built around 1100 on 9th-century Carolingian foundations and contains eleven altars and early-Romanesque frescoes.
quote: The nunnery, founded in 772, is the oldest in Germany ... built around the year 1100 on Carolingian foundation walls from the 9th century ... eleven altars, early Romanesque frescoes

claim: Guided 45-minute tours of the Frauenwörth minster by a nun cost €6 per person (€70 for groups up to 12), held weekdays between 11:00 and 13:00 by appointment; church services take precedence.
quote: approximately 45 minutes, meet at the monastery gate, cost 6.00€ per person (or 70.00€ for groups up to 12 people) ... excluding Sundays and holidays

claim: Schloss Hohenaschau in Aschau im Chiemgau is only visitable on a guided tour (May-October); slots run Tue/Thu/Sun/holidays 13:30 & 15:00 and Wed/Fri 10:00 & 11:30; adults €7, children 6-16 €5, family card €15; the steep castle hill needs a 15-20 min uphill walk.
quote: Das Schloss ist nur mit einer Führung zu besichtigen ... Tuesday & Thursday: 1:30 PM & 3:00 PM ... Adults €7.00 ... Allow 15-20 minutes walking uphill

claim: The Falknerei Burg Hohenaschau holds 45-minute raptor flight demonstrations through 18 October 2026 at 11:00 and 15:00; tickets €10 adults / €5 children 5-15 / €28 family, cash only, weather-dependent.
quote: Adults: €10.00, Children (5-15 years): €5.00, Family tickets ... €28.00 ... demonstration lasts approximately 45 minutes ... No card payments are accepted

claim: The Holzknechtmuseum Ruhpolding is open Easter-October, Tue-Sun 10:00-17:00; admission €9 adults, €8 seniors, €7 youth/students to 27, family €20, under-6 free; fully accessible, bilingual German/English, dogs free.
quote: Ostern bis Oktober jeweils Dienstag bis Sonntag, jeweils 10 bis 17 Uhr ... Adults: €9.00 ... Families (up to 2 adults + children): €20.00

claim: The Holzknechtmuseum is a Bezirk-Oberbayern open-air museum recreating the working world of the Chiemgau Holzknechte (woodcutters), with historic huts, sleds, tools and a multimedia journey through forestry history.
quote: Holzknechtmuseum Ruhpolding / Bezirk Oberbayern

claim: Maria Eck above Siegsdorf is the most-visited pilgrimage site in the Archdiocese of Munich-Freising, a 1626 Franciscan monastery and church at 882 m with adjoining Gasthof, frequently combined with a hike from the Eckerwirt parking area.
quote: Maria Eck is a monastery of the Franciscan Minorites from 1626 ... pilgrimage church at 882 meters above sea level is the most well-known pilgrimage church in the Diocese of Munich and Freising

claim: The Maria Klobenstein pilgrimage church lies directly on the Bavarian-Tyrolean border between Schleching and Kössen in the Tiroler-Ache gorge; a Loreto Chapel (1701) and a Mariahilf Chapel (1731-33) were joined into one church in 1890, built around a venerated split rock and spring.
quote: directly on the German-Austrian border between Schleching (Bavaria) and Kössen (Tyrol) ... Loreto Chapel was built in 1701, and the Mariahilf Chapel was built between 1731 and 1733. Since 1890, the two chapels have been structurally connected

claim: The Salinenpark Traunstein, opened 2019 for the city's 400th salt-works anniversary, is a freely accessible open-air museum showing a reconstructed Reiffenstuel pump-wheel and a working 19th-century Reichenbach water-column engine, plus an apothecary garden of ~140 medicinal species.
quote: Salinenpark was opened in 2019 on the occasion of the 400th anniversary of the salt city Traunstein ... reconstruction of the so-called Reiffenstuelpumpe ... original, still functioning Reichenbach water column machine

claim: Inside the Ferdinandistock and Albertistock of the Traunstein Salinen ensemble, an exhibition on the Soleleitung lets visitors take a virtual flight along 'the oldest pipeline in the world', complementing the baroque Salinenkapelle St. Rupert & Maximilian (1630-31).
quote: exhibition has been set up in the Ferdinandistock ... virtual flight journey along the 'oldest pipeline in the world' ... Salinenkapelle St. Rupert and St. Maximilian ... erected between 1630 and 1631

claim: Burg Marquartstein, founded 1075 on a rocky spur above the Tiroler Ache, is the historic core of the Achental; in 1894 Richard Strauss married soprano Pauline de Ahna in the castle church, and the privately owned castle is best appreciated from circular hiking trails (e.g. from Freiweidach).
quote: history as a place begins in 1075 with the construction of Marquartstein Castle ... On September 10, 1894, the famous musician and composer Richard Strauss married his student, the singer Pauline de Ahna, in the castle church

claim: The Salzbergwerk Berchtesgaden (~50 km from Grassau, beyond the strict 30-km radius but a feasible day-trip) offers ~1 h guided underground tours with miner's outfits, two ~40 m slides, a train ride and a raft crossing of an underground brine lake; budget 1.5-2 h on site.
quote: you should allow 1.5 to 2 hours including ticket purchase, dressing, reception and return of miner's clothing. The tour through the world beneath the surface lasts a good hour

claim: Grassau to Aschau im Chiemgau is about 13-14 km by road (≈20-min drive), and Grassau to Ruhpolding about 28 km (≈22 min), placing both squarely within day-trip range.
quote: Grassau - Aschau im Chiemgau driving directions

claim: Reit im Winkl's historic center has houses around the town hall plus a Heimatmuseum and a ski museum holding one of Europe's biggest ski collections, alongside the Catholic Pfarrkirche St. Pankratius.
quote: the 'Heimatmuseum' (Museum of Local History) and a ski museum with one of the biggest ski collections in Europe ... historical houses around the town hall, and the Catholic Church St. Pankratius

claim: Reit im Winkl was put on the international map by double-Olympic-gold skier Rosi Mittermaier, born on the Winklmoosalm above the town at 1,170 m.
quote: The Winklmoosalm sits at 1,170 meters elevation ... double Olympic gold medalist Rosi Mittermaier was born on the Winklmoos-Alm and made the location internationally known

claim: The valley offers more than 200 km of classic and skating cross-country trails — German national biathlon and Langlauf squads use the snow-sure Winklmoos- and Hemmersuppenalm tracks for altitude training.
quote: more than 200 kilometers of classic trails and skating trails. German cross-country and biathlon stars train on the Reit im Winkl elevation trails

claim: Aschau im Chiemgau's late-medieval Residenz Heinz Winkler was converted by Winkler in 1989 into a 32-room boutique hotel whose Restaurant Epicures regained its Michelin star in March 2024.
quote: The late medieval complex in the heart of Aschau was transformed into an elegant luxury boutique hotel by Heinz Winkler in 1989 ... The Gourmet Restaurant has held a Michelin-star since March 2024

claim: The castle's Falknerei (falconry) holds daily flight demonstrations at 11:00 and 15:00 in peak season, with eagles and falcons swooping over the courtyard.
quote: Flight demonstrations occur daily at 11 AM and 3 PM during peak season

claim: Aschau is nicknamed the 'Bankerldorf' for the 470+ benches and 200 themed benches scattered along its walking paths and Kurpark.
quote: Aschau im Chiemgau is also called the 'Bankerldorf' (banker village) because over 470 benches and 200 themed benches are installed there

claim: Café Pauli, a family-run institution in Aschau since 1949, serves homemade cakes, coffee specialities and ice cream with a beer garden.
quote: Café Pauli has been a family business since 1949 and offers hearty snacks, homemade cakes, coffee specialties and ice cream in cozy guest rooms and a beer garden

claim: Prien's pedestrianised Altstadt centres on an attractive market square with traditional Bavarian buildings, owner-run boutiques, Trachten shops like Chiceria, and the 'Grüne Markt' farmers' market every Friday 07:00–12:30.
quote: A farmers market called 'Grüne Markt' operates Fridays from 7:00 to 12:30 AM on the central plaza, offering regional fresh produce ... pedestrian zone hosts diverse retail experiences

claim: Prien is the gateway to the Chiemsee via the Chiemsee-Bahn — a 1.9 km steam tram running since 10 July 1887, the world's oldest continuously operated steam street car, ferrying visitors from Prien station to the Stock harbour in about eight minutes for onward boats to Herren- and Fraueninsel.
quote: 1.9 km long narrow-gauge railway ... has connected Prien railway station to the port of Prien am Chiemsee since July 10, 1887. It is the oldest, continuously operating steam tram railway in the world

claim: Bernau's sights cluster around the Kath. Pfarrkirche St. Laurentius, the Kuratiekirche St. Bartholomäus in Hittenkirchen, a 150-year-old Mariengrotte in Kraimoos and a Kurpark, with the Wasserturm in Bergham offering the best lake panorama.
quote: Wasserturm in Bergham: 'one of the most beautiful views of Bernau and Lake Chiemsee with the Herren- and Fraueninsel' ... Mariengrotte in Kraimoos (150+ year old grotto shrine)

claim: Bernau celebrates its 1,100-year jubilee in 2026 with a traditional Maibaumaufstellen in the village centre featuring local Trachtler groups, music and catering into the night.
quote: the traditional Maibaumaufstellen in the Bernau town center for the 1100-year anniversary celebration ... accompanied by performances from local traditional costume groups (Trachtler)

claim: Ruhpolding's landmark Pfarrkirche St. Georg, begun 1738 and consecrated 1754, is a high-Rococo jewel whose left-side pulpit is unmatched in Bavaria; it shelters the c.1220/30 'Ruhpoldinger Madonna', one of the oldest Marienfiguren in the archdiocese.
quote: built in the first half of the 18th century in the Rococo style ... pulpit on the left side, which has no equal in the Bavarian region ... Ruhpoldinger Madonna, an enthroned Mary figure with Christ child from around 1220/30

claim: Just south of Ruhpolding the Holzknechtmuseum — re-curated in 2021 — takes visitors on a multimedia trip through 400 years of Bavarian and Austrian forestry life across 30,000 m² with three indoor levels and a themed outdoor trail (open May 1–Oct 31, Tue–Sun 10–17).
quote: multimedia journey through 400 years of social and economic history of forestry work ... spans 30,000 square meters with a barrier-free main building featuring 3 exhibition levels and a thematic outdoor trail ... open from May 1 to October 31, 2026, Tuesday to Sunday from 10 AM to 5 PM

claim: Übersee fronts Bavaria's longest sandy Chiemsee beach — a 40,000 m² lido with a modern Strandcafé, volleyball, table-tennis and two kiosks.
quote: longest sandy beach in Bavaria. The approximately 40,000m² lido area offers wonderful views of the sparkling lake ... a modern beach café and many sports activities

claim: Marquartstein's skyline is dominated by Burg Marquartstein (1075, still in private hands), with the Hochplattenbahn chairlift, Schnappenkirche pilgrimage church, and a Märchen-Erlebnispark with summer toboggan run; Richard Strauss married here in 1894 and composed operas during summer stays.
quote: picturesque townscape is dominated by Marquartstein Castle, constructed in 1075 ... The composer Richard Strauss married here in 1894 and wrote operas during summer stays

claim: From 23 July to 2 August 2026 Marquartstein hosts the 88th Gautrachtenfest of the Chiemgau Alpenverband — a double-centennial Trachten gathering with parades and folk music.
quote: From July 23 to August 2, 2026, the 88th Gautrachtenfest of the Chiemgau Alpine Association will take place, celebrating a double centennial

claim: Chieming hugs the eastern Chiemsee shore with 6 km of free, flat, barrier-free promenade, viewing platforms, lakeside cafés and beer gardens, a bee-and-fruit Lehrpfad, a Kneipp facility and ferries to Fraueninsel from its jetty.
quote: promenade of Chieming on the east shore invites families to stroll along ... 6-kilometer-long, freely accessible and flat shore ... ship connections to the Fraueninsel

claim: Bergen's Hochfelln-Seilbahn lifts visitors in 15 minutes (in two sections) to the 1,674 m summit for sweeping Chiemsee and central-Alps panoramas; from 4–7 June 2026 the mid-station hosts the open-air Hochfellnfestival.
quote: From June 4-7, 2026, the scenic middle station of the Hochfelln cable car in Bergen transforms into a stage ... brings you conveniently and safely to the viewing terrace of Chiemgau in just 15 minutes, to the 1,674-meter-high Hochfelln

claim: From Grassau, Reit im Winkl is ~18 km / under 25 min by road; Prien ~12 km; Aschau ~16 km from Prien (so ~20-25 km from Grassau) — all comfortably within a 30 km half-day radius.
quote: The road distance is 11.1 miles (approximately 18 km by car) ... Grassau is 12 km from Prien am Chiemsee ... Aschau im Chiemgau is 16 km from Prien am Chiemsee

claim: Chiemgau Thermen Bad Endorf day-ticket prices (May 2026): Therme 31 EUR, Therme+Sauna 39 EUR; weekend/holiday surcharge +5 EUR; family 2 adults+1 child day-ticket 74 EUR; sauna access from age 16.
quote: Therme (Day ticket): €31.00 ... Sauna + Therme (Day ticket): €39.00 ... Weekend/Holiday surcharge: +€5.00 ... 2 adults + 1 child (day ticket): €74.00 ... Sauna-Zutritt ab 16 Jahren

claim: Chiemgau Thermen opening hours: thermal landscape and sauna world daily 09:00-22:00, wellness 10:00-21:30, last entry 45 minutes before closing.
quote: Thermenlandschaft: täglich 09.00 – 22.00 Uhr ... Saunawelt: täglich 09.00 – 22.00 Uhr ... Wellness: täglich 10.00 – 21.30 Uhr

claim: Chiemgau Thermen uses one of Europe's strongest iodine thermal springs (~35°C) drilled in 1962 at ~5,000 m depth; ~1,800 m² water surface with rock lagoon, 125 m current channel, outdoor whirlpool, activity pool.
quote: one of the strongest iodine thermal spring sources in Europe ... thermal landscape offers approximately 1,800 m² of water surface ... 125-meter-long current channel

claim: Chiemsee-Radweg is 53.3 km, 159 m total climbing, rated moderate; passes Prien, Rimsting, Breitbrunn, Gollenshausen, Seebruck, Chieming, Grabenstätt, Übersee-Feldwies, returning via Bernau/Felden.
quote: Total Length: 53.3 km ... 159 meters of total climbing ... Difficulty Rating: Mittel (Moderate)

claim: Achental-Radweg is roughly 70 km with only 248 m elevation gain, mostly on paved paths away from roads, rated medium difficulty; follows the Tiroler Ache valley.
quote: Distance: 70 km ... Elevation Gain: 248 m ... well-developed, paved trails mostly away from roads

claim: Grassau-promoted family e-bike route Osterbuchberg Runde is an easy 19.2 km loop (~1.5 h); Achen-Achter is a 40 km moderate loop through glacial foothills.
quote: Osterbuchberg Runde - An easy 19.2 km family-friendly route lasting about 1.5 hours ... Achen-Achter - A moderate 40 km loop

claim: Südbike24 in Übersee (Gewerbestr. 6, 5 km from Grassau) rents 10-15 e-bikes including e-trekking, e-city and e-MTB; Mon-Fri 9:30-12 and 13-18, Sat 9-12.
quote: Address: Gewerbestraße 6, 83236 Übersee ... gravel, trekking, city bikes as well as high-quality mountain bikes and e-bikes ... 10-15 e-bikes in stock

claim: Kurt Bartsch operates a bike rental directly in Grassau/Achental with delivery and pickup to vacation accommodations.
quote: Welcome to the bicycle rental Grassau - Achental ... offer delivery and pickup services to vacation accommodations

claim: Reifinger See in Grassau is a free 20,000 m² bathing lake with non-swimmer/toddler zone, beach volleyball, changing rooms, barrier-free water access and Chiemgau Alps views.
quote: butterfly-shaped bathing lake in Grassau with a water surface of 20,000 square meters ... non-swimmer and toddler bathing zone ... beach volleyball court ... barrier-free water access ... Admission is free

claim: Reifinger Badesee details: 540 m elevation, 0.02 km² surface, 8 m depth, open 08:00-21:00, no admission fee, free parking, no lifeguard, dogs banned May-Sept.
quote: Elevation: 540 m ... Surface: 0.02 km² ... Depth: 8 m ... Hours: 08:00 - 21:00 ... no admission fee and complimentary parking ... Dogs prohibited May-September

claim: Wössner See in Unterwössen (~10 km from Grassau) is a free natural bathing lake with sun terrace, water slide, children's play area and Seestüberl restaurant; swimming at own risk (no lifeguard).
quote: idyllic natural bathing lake ... well-maintained public bathing area with sun terrace, water slide, and children's play area ... entry fee to the small lake swimming area is free

claim: Taubensee near Schleching is a 3.6 ha mountain lake (40 m deep) reachable only on foot via Kroatensteig; the Bavaria-Tyrol border runs through the lake, summer water temperatures reach ~24°C.
quote: area of about 3.6 hectares and a maximum depth of 40 meters ... border line between Bavaria and Tyrol runs directly through the lake ... warms up to about 24 degrees Celsius in summer

claim: Three-lakes area Weitsee-Mittersee-Lödensee between Reit im Winkl and Ruhpolding (within 30 km of Grassau) offers swimming in drinking-water-quality lakes in a nature reserve.
quote: Weitsee, Mittersee, and Lödensee form a three-lake area, all of which allow swimming ... water is of drinking water quality

claim: HEIUKI SUP rental at Julius-Exter-Promenade 15, Übersee operates daily May-October with contactless self-service booking; suggested routes include 3 km beginner tour to Feldwieser Bay and 6 km circuit around Krautinsel.
quote: Julius-Exter-Promenade 15, 83236 Übersee ... daily from May to October during daylight hours ... 3km beginner-friendly tour to Feldwieser Bay ... 6km advanced route circumnavigating Kraut Island

claim: Chiemsee-Alpenland tourism board lists multiple SUP rental hubs around the lake including Übersee, Bernau-Felden, Seebruck and Chieming Strandbad (rentals from May).
quote: Stand Up Paddling in der Region ... In the public beach area (Strandbad) of Chieming, you can rent SUPs from May onward

claim: Chiemgau Coaster in Ruhpolding is open daily 10:00-18:00 June-early Nov; adult single ride €6.00, child passenger €3.00, 1-hour flatrate €33.00
quote: täglich geöffnet von 10.00 Uhr bis 18.00 Uhr ... Erwachsene Einzelfahrt 6,00 € ... 1-Stunden-Flatrate 33,00 €

claim: Chiemgau Coaster is a 1,100 m alpine coaster with two loops crossing over a hiking trail at 7 m height in Ruhpolding (Hauptstraße 2b)
quote: Die 1.100 Meter lange Sommerrodelbahn überquert einen Wanderweg und führt dann durch zwei actionreiche Loopings in über 7 Metern Höhe
